title: DNS Check Credit on Certificate Installation
content:
**Domain team credit note: DNS check credit on managed installations of SSL/TLS Certificates**

A managed installation of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries a fixed DNS check credit against the managed installation charge. The credit applies when the certificate's linked domain is a Harborline registration under Domain Registrations whose status is active. Its amount follows that registration's nameservers:

- **Active registration on Harborline DNS.** DNS check credit of USD 2.00. Harborline checks the records itself.
- **Active registration on external nameservers.** DNS check credit of USD 1.00.
- **Any other case.** No DNS check credit. This covers a certificate whose domain is registered elsewhere (no linked Harborline domain) and a linked Harborline registration whose status is anything other than active.

**Condition table**

| Linked Harborline registration | Registration status | Nameservers | DNS check credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | active | Harborline DNS | USD 2.00 |
| yes | active | external | USD 1.00 |
| yes | not active | any | none |
| no linked registration | — | — | none |

Both conditions are read from the Domain Registrations record on the day the managed installation is booked: the registration's status and its nameserver setting. The credit is one fixed amount per managed installation.
